contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ D N VALEN-S P F AVG

A copper-alloy nummus of Valens, AD 364-378 (Reece period 19). Reverse shows Victory advancing left, holding wreath and palm (in style of Arles mint). Mint is probably Arles, AD 364-378. Obverse legend reads D N VALEN-S P F AVG. Obverse shows Perl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //[...]. Condition is fine, die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 2.04g,…
